title: Royal Magic — cartola do embaralhamento
prompt: Create ONE original transparent 2D cartoon game sprite for Royal Magic: a beautiful classic magician's top hat, in almost black dark plum purple. The referenced colorful Royal Magic power-up image is a style reference only for crisp painted outlines, broad soft gradients, smooth cartoon bevels and toy-like clarity. The subject is a compact recognizable theatrical top hat: medium tall gently tapered cylindrical crown with a tiny flare at the open top, a broad simple softly curved oval brim, one understated dark plum ribbon around the lower crown. Angle: nearly upright with a very subtle charismatic slant, seen from a front three-quarter viewpoint slightly ABOVE it. The OVAL OPEN MOUTH at the top must be clearly visible, with a thin rounded dark purple lip and an empty near-black violet interior, so pieces could drop into it in a later animation. No lid; the structural opening and solid brim are visibly distinct shapes. Plump clean geometry with an elegant simple silhouette and minimal detailing, refined matte satin material, restrained upper-left purple rim lights and one broad subtle side highlight. Keep approximately 85–90% of the sprite in the very dark black-purple family, around #140B20, #1B102B and #231333, and use #462960 only along a few narrow painted highlights so the silhouette reads. Ribbon remains tone-on-tone deep purple, no metal buckle or gold accents. Real painted 2D casual-game graphic, polished, warm violet reflected light, stable smooth alpha silhouette. Empty open hat only. Do not draw any game pieces, magic effects, glow, smoke, sparkles, symbols, stitching details, typography, shadows outside the silhouette, scene floor, background, interface, hands, head, bunny or extra objects. No purple neon, no realistic fabric grain or photographic rendering. A single standalone upright hat on a truly transparent square PNG canvas, entirely visible, with 12% clear margin.
